correctness.rationale: For each reduced p/q the cited plateau theorem gives identical weight C_h/(exp(hq)-1), and the irrational set has measure zero; summing over phi(q) yields the exact marginal. The totient Lambert-series identity proves normalization. The summatory totient theorem gives scaled denominator measure density 6t/pi^2. Möbius inversion yields the uniform reduced-numerator estimate with O(tau(q)) error; tau(q)<=2 sqrt(q) makes weighted compact-window errors O(sqrt(h)), proving independence. Uniform O(a) small-scale mass and O((b+1)exp(-b)) large-scale mass extend convergence and ensure all polynomial moments. Positive-series integration gives Gamma(k+2) zeta(k+2). Standalone exact rational cycle tests passed and are explicitly not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The least attracting period is a natural observable of a parameter-dependent mode-locking staircase. Its typical scale diverges as dissipation vanishes, and a complete nondegenerate universal limit simultaneously tracks rotation phase and cycle length, with the surprising factorization of their limiting law and all mixed moments. The named quantitative invariant is directly motivated by full statistical characterization of the singular weak-contraction transition and is not a chosen arbitrary finite parameter slice. Formulae for individual rational locking plateaux are already known and are not misrepresented as novel.
